_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Discarding a failed floating recording releases orphaned previews without touching the viewed composer. The test seeded a separate draft conversation {{VIEWED}} with the draft text "Keep the viewed draft.". The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". window.__recordingMock.revokedPreviews lists the object URLs the page revoked. To "paste file F": eval window.__pasteFile(F), passing contents C and type T as further arguments only when the step names them, which pastes such a file into the message input; then wait until exactly one ".message-attachment-ready" exists. To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". Draft creations fail with "draft unavailable". Attachment uploads (POST /api/upload) answer with the path /tmp/shelley-uploads/attachment.png, and recording uploads with /tmp/shelley-uploads/discarded.webm. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. Paste file "source.png" with contents "image" and type "image/png".
2. Save the preview: eval "window.__preview = document.querySelector('.message-attachment-thumb').getAttribute('src')".
3. Click the voice button. [data-testid="recording-error"] should come to contain "draft unavailable", and the recording state should be "recording".
4. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. Paste file "viewed.txt".
5. Click the stop button. [data-testid="recording-retained"] should become visible.
6. Eval "JSON.stringify(window.__recordingMock.revokedPreviews)" must return "[]".
7. Click the cancel button. No recording panel should remain (count 0).
8. Eval "JSON.stringify(window.__recordingMock.revokedPreviews) === JSON.stringify([window.__preview])" must be true.
9. The message input should have the value "Keep the viewed draft.", and ".message-attachment-ready" should contain "viewed.txt".
